title: Trinity plutonium fallout plume over Roswell
place_text: Trinity site and Roswell, New Mexico

tellings.quote: plume full of plutonium uh that didn't get burned up in the explosion, it just was still there passed over Roswell, so there had a big strip of of uh ur- uranium uh plutonium contaminated soil around Roswell

plain: After Trinity, the first atomic bomb test in New Mexico in 1945, a cloud of plutonium that didn't burn up in the blast is said to have drifted over the town of Roswell and left a strip of contaminated soil around it. The physicist John Brandenburg passes this on as something he was told. It matters to him because Roswell is the town later linked to a claimed 1947 crash, so radioactive ground there could be part of that story.
